name: comparable_monthly_yoy_summary
purpose: Show the monthly year-on-year summary for the comparable store population using the business month axis.
intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] DESC. This uses the business month axis and avoids using 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] for trading period analysis.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month],
        TREATAS(
            {"ST4","ST1","ST3","ST2","ST5"},
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
        ),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %]
    ),
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month], DESC
)

name: latest_load_dates
purpose: Confirm the latest available batch/load dates that frame the reporting cut-off.
intent: Return one row with MAX of 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date], MAX of 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[max_date], and MAX of 'Latest_Refresh_Table'[MaxRefreshDate], with no grouping. This is for reporting cut-off context only and not for daily trading analysis.
dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "MIS_DEEP_DIVE2 max_date", FORMAT(MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date]), "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn"),
    "MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB max_date", FORMAT(MAX('MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[max_date]), "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn"),
    "Latest_Refresh_Table MaxRefreshDate", FORMAT(MAX('Latest_Refresh_Table'[MaxRefreshDate]), "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn")
)

name: store_month_matrix
purpose: Show which comparable stores drove the most recent monthly revenue positions across months.
intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [net bills CURRENT], and [bills growth]. Limit to 15 row combinations and sort first by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] DESC, then by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    FILTER(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month],
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth]
        ),
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] IN {"ST4","ST1","ST3","ST2","ST5"}
    ),
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month], DESC,
    [net revenue CURRENT], DESC
)
